title: Infant formula, Similac Isomil Soy, ready-to-feed

content.title: About
content.content: Similac Isomil Soy is a ready-to-feed soy-based infant formula designed for newborns and infants who are intolerant to lactose or cow's milk protein. It provides a carefully balanced blend of nutrients—including protein, fat, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals—essential for a child's growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is completely ready to use – no water mixing required.
Soy-based protein offers an alternative for babies with cow's milk allergy.
Each container holds 368 ml of product, making it convenient for travel.
Enriched with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Clinically tested to confirm safety and efficacy.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: A balanced mix of macro‑ and micronutrients promotes normal growth and development.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Soy protein is easily digestible and provides essential amino acids.

items.title: Contains DHA and ARA
items.content: These omega‑fatty acids are crucial for brain and visual system development.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for infants with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Includes iron, calcium, vitamin D, and other nutrients important for bone health and immunity.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergic reaction to soy proteins.

items.title: Not a complete breast milk substitute
items.content: Should be used as an alternative only under pediatric guidance.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Contains added carbohydrates like most infant formulas; monitor intake for children prone to cavities.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the container refrigerated and use within 48 hours.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the ready-to-feed formula at room temperature. If desired, chill in the refrigerator. Do not heat in a microwave to avoid hot spots. Offer small amounts and observe the infant’s response.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 48 hours. Discard if the product develops an off‑smell, color, or taste.
